definitions.explanation: A structured program in which students or recent graduates gain practical work experience at a company or organization for a limited period. In Japan, internships are a key part of the job-hunting process, typically undertaken during the third year of university.

examples.japanese: インターンシップ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧インターンシップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I did an internship during summer break.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧インターンシップ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Through that internship, I was able to learn how actual work flows.

notes:
From English 'internship.' Often abbreviated to ⟦インターン→インターン：24404_intaan⟧ in casual speech. In Japan's ⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧ (job-hunting) culture, internships serve partly as a way for companies to evaluate potential recruits, and for students to gauge corporate culture before applying. Programs range from one-day company visits to multi-week placements.

USAGE:
- Short-term internships (⟦{短期|たんき}→短期：04050_tanki⟧インターンシップ) of one to five days are very common in Japan and often function more like company information sessions.
- Long-term internships (⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧インターンシップ) of several months more closely resemble the Western model of sustained work experience.
- The verb pattern is インターンシップ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ or インターンシップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- インターンシップ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate in an internship
- インターンシップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to experience an internship
- インターンシップ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: internship placement; host company
- インターンシップ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: internship system
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧インターンシップ: summer internship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インターン→インターン：24404_intaan⟧: intern; internship — shortened form used casually, can refer to both the person and the program
- ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: training — broader term for any professional training or orientation, not limited to students
- {職場体験|しょくばたいけん}: workplace experience — a similar concept used at the middle-school and high-school level
